definitions.gloss: to recommend; to endorse; to advocate
definitions.explanation: To formally recommend something as good or suitable. More formal than すすめる, often used in official or institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}が{推奨|すいしょう}する。
この{方法|ほうほう}はメーカーが{推奨|すいしょう}している。
examples.english: This method is recommended by the manufacturer.

examples.japanese: {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}は{一日|いちにち}{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}の{運動|うんどう}を{推奨|すいしょう}している。
examples.english: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare recommends 30 minutes of exercise per day.

notes:
FORMS:
{推|すい} (push, promote) + {奨|しょう} (encourage)

REGISTER:
More formal and official than {勧|すす}める (to recommend). Used in product specifications, government guidelines, academic writing, and technical documentation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {推奨|すいしょう}{環境|かんきょう}: recommended system requirements
- {推奨|すいしょう}{量|りょう}: recommended amount/dosage
- {推奨|すいしょう}{品|ひん}: recommended product
- {非推奨|ひすいしょう}: deprecated, not recommended

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {推奨|すいしょう}する: to recommend (formal, institutional)
- {勧|すす}める: to recommend (general, personal)
- {薦|すす}める: to recommend a person or thing (literary)
